items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: We played the Graystone with Stan Kenton and that band swung all night long.

ctx.x: There's some beautiful stories about that band, too. We played the Graystone with Stan Kenton and that band swung all night long. They took us out of the ballroom and put us in the garden and the people were screaming when we finished there. And Stan asked his band to leave and they wouldn't leave. We was playing the last set. And we swung all night long and we didn't play the greatest thing, "Diminuendo and Crescendo", till the very last tune. We didn't even need it.
